crossRefs.keyword: perish not. Heb. be not cut off

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”
translations.bsb: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt. Then the country will not perish in the famine.”
translations.kjv: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
translations.asv: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
